title: Junior Designer Color & Materials, Kids Footwear
note: Junior CMF role on PUMA's kids footwear team at the German headquarters; portfolio and CV required.

facts.summary: Junior color and materials designer for PUMA's Kids Footwear category, reporting to the footwear design team head.
facts.duties: Build seasonal color and material stories, support material sourcing and new finishes, create designs and material combinations, do trend research and prepare review material.
facts.requirements: Completed design degree; portfolio showing color and material sense; some color/material/graphic/footwear design experience; Illustrator and Photoshop.
facts.apply: Apply online and upload portfolio with CV.
